mapper.sql: select v.vehicle_id, v.vehicle_type, v.model_name, v.title, v.guide_price, v.original_price, v.color, v.stock, v.merchant_id, v.description, v.tags, v.view_count, v.status, v.publish_time, v.create_time, v.update_time, m.merchant_name, u.used_id, u.mileage, u.license_year, u.license_month, u.license_city, u.transfer_count, u.battery_soh, u.battery_cycles, u.battery_diagnosis, s.range_km, s.battery_capacity, s.charge_time_fast from stad_vehicle v left join stad_merchant m on v.merchant_id = m.merchant_id left join stad_vehicle_used u on v.vehicle_id = u.vehicle_id left join stad_vehicle_spec s on v.vehicle_id = s.vehicle_id
mapper.select: select v.vehicle_id, v.vehicle_type, v.model_name, v.title, v.guide_price, v.original_price, v.color, v.stock, v.merchant_id, v.description, v.tags, v.view_count, v.status, v.publish_time, v.create_time, v.update_time, m.merchant_name, s.spec_id, s.vehicle_id as spec_vehicle_id, s.range_km, s.battery_capacity, s.charge_time_fast, s.charge_time_slow, s.model_year from stad_vehicle v left join stad_merchant m on v.merchant_id = m.merchant_id left join stad_vehicle_spec s on v.vehicle_id = s.vehicle_id where v.vehicle_id = #{vehicleId}

mapper.insert: insert into stad_vehicle_spec (vehicle_id, range_km, battery_capacity, charge_time_fast, charge_time_slow, model_year) values (#{vehicleId}, #{rangeKm}, #{batteryCapacity}, #{chargeTimeFast}, #{chargeTimeSlow}, #{modelYear})
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stad_vehicle) AS vehicleCount, IFNULL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stad_unified_order WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()), 0) AS todayOrderCount, IFNULL((SELECT SUM(total_amount) FROM stad_unified_order WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() AND status IN ('1','2')), 0) AS todayRevenue, IFNULL((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM stad_unified_order WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()), 0) AS activeUserCount

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stad_unified_order WHERE vehicle_id = #{vehicleId} AND status IN ('2','3')) AS totalSales, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stad_unified_order WHERE vehicle_id = #{vehicleId} AND status IN ('2','3') AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m')) AS monthSales, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stad_vehicle_review WHERE vehicle_id = #{vehicleId} AND status = '1') AS reviewCount, IFNULL((SELECT ROUND(AVG(rating), 1) FROM stad_vehicle_review WHERE vehicle_id = #{vehicleId} AND status = '1'), 0) AS avgRating

select v.vehicle_id, v.vehicle_type, u.used_id, u.battery_soh, u.battery_cycles, u.battery_diagnosis from stad_vehicle v left join stad_vehicle_used u on v.vehicle_id = u.vehicle_id where v.vehicle_id = #{vehicleId}
